content: GitLab Ireland provides 100% salary for up to 16 weeks of maternity leave [1]. This support includes a top-up to the state benefit of €262 per week [1].

messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Maternity Leave]
GitLab provides comprehensive maternity leave support that goes beyond statutory requirements.  

Statutory Entitlement

- 26 weeks ordinary maternity leave  
- Additional 16 weeks unpaid leave available  
- Must start 2 weeks before due date  
- Minimum 4 weeks after birth

  

GitLab Support

- 100% salary for up to 16 weeks (includes state benefit top-up)  
- State Maternity Benefit: €262/week (subject to PRSI)  
- Support throughout your leave journey

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com with start/end dates
2. Receive completed MB2 form from Absence Management
3. Apply via [gov.ie](https://www.gov.ie/en/service/apply-for-maternity-benefit/) at least 6 weeks before leave
4. Submit time off in Workday (Parental Leave category)

[2] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Carer's Leave]
Support when caring for loved ones.  

Leave Entitlement

- Up to 104 weeks unpaid leave  
- For full-time care of qualifying person  
- Minimum 13-week periods  
- GitLab provides 100% salary for first 25 working days if receiving state benefit

  

How to Apply

1. Submit written notice to leaves@gitlab.com 6 weeks in advance
2. Provide Department decision on care requirements
3. Complete confirmation document 2 weeks before leave

[3] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Parent's Leave]
Extended support for new parents.  

Leave Entitlement

- 9 weeks leave in child's first 2 years  
- Can be taken consecutively or separately  
- State Parent's Benefit available (subject to PRSI)  
- GitLab salary top-up applies if taken within the first 16 weeks of GitLab's Parental Leave

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com 6 weeks in advance
2. Apply for benefit via [gov.ie](https://www.gov.ie/en/service/b321b1-parents-benefit/) 4 weeks before leave

[4] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Adoptive Leave]
Comprehensive support for growing families.  

Statutory Entitlement

- 24 weeks ordinary adoptive leave  
- Additional 16 weeks unpaid leave available  
- Begins on placement date

  

GitLab Support

- 100% salary for up to 16 weeks (includes state benefit top-up)  
- State Adoptive Benefit: €262/week (subject to PRSI)

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com with dates
2. Apply via [gov.ie](https://www.gov.ie/en/service/295b84-adoptive-benefit/) at least 6 weeks before leave
3. Submit time off in Workday

[5] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Parental Leave]
Flexibility for ongoing childcare needs.  

Leave Entitlement

- Up to 26 weeks unpaid leave  
- For children under 12 (16 with disability)  
- Can split into blocks with manager approval  
- Requires 1 year employment

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com 6 weeks in advance
2. Sign confirmation document 4 weeks before leave

[6] [GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Maternity Leave]
Leave Entitlement

- Team members must have continuous employment with GitLab for at least 26 weeks leading up to the "qualifying week" (15th week before the expected week of childbirth)
- Up to 52 weeks leave available
- First 39 weeks paid (combining statutory and GitLab benefits)
- 90% of average earnings for first 6 weeks (before tax), then statutory rate (£194.32/week) or 90% (whichever is lower) of the team member's average weekly earnings (whichever is lower) for the next 33 weeks. This also applies to the leave amounts provided for Parental Leave and Adoption Leave.
- GitLab's enhanced policy provides up to 16 weeks at 100% salary
